dogecoin.text:
@JRNYcrypto It's fine - it'll pump again eventually the next time Elon is bored and gets his phone privileges back. 

Still, wouldn't mind $DOGE, $SHIB, $ASS, and the likes being obliterated out of the market to make room for fundamentally sounds projects that give crypto a good name.

@davidgokhshtein It’s unfortunate because despite its popularity, $DOGE is fundamentally invalid, easily manipulated, and is a poor display of what #crypto and #Bitcoin offer and represent. 

If #dogecoin can bring in more eyes and investors, awesome; hopefully they check out other projects too.
